Financial services (e.g. solar financing, consórcio, credit) need local licences in Brazil — keep financing out of the ad. TikTok's Lead Generation Terms page is JS-rendered and could not be read; a search snippet says an advertiser using lead gen 'on behalf of a third party… will only use or share the Lead Generation Data on behalf of that third party' — UNVERIFIED, and it would bite a native-form lead RESOLD to several buyers ⇒ capture on her own landing page/WhatsApp, not native forms, until read. Meta: +12,15% tax pass-through since 1 Jan 2026 (Meta letter); Meta's Lead Ads Terms and minimum-budget pages are JS-blocked from this environment — UNVERIFIED. No energy-specific special ad category found (UNVERIFIED). Telephone: Anatel made the 0303 telemarketing prefix OPTIONAL (Acórdão 201, 14 Aug 2025; page modified 28/08/2026); mandatory call authentication only above 500.000 calls/month; 'Não Me Perturbe' covers telecom and consignado only — her Portuguese call-backs to opted-in leads are unrestricted by Anatel.
lgpd: Consent is the only clean basis for RESELLING a lead. LGPD art. 7 I (consent) and art. 7 §5 verbatim: 'O controlador que obteve o consentimento… que necessitar comunicar ou compartilhar dados pessoais com outros controladores deverá obter consentimento específico do titular para esse fim'. Art. 8 §4: 'autorizações genéricas… serão nulas'; art. 9 V requires disclosure of 'uso compartilhado… e a finalidade' and §1 voids consent obtained with misleading or non-prior information; art. 18 VII gives the titular the right to know every entity it was shared with. ANPD's legitimate-interest guide (Feb 2024) lists 'foram obtidos por meio de compartilhamento realizado por terceiros?' as a legitimate-expectation factor — resale on legitimate interest is weak. Energy-specific: Decreto 13.097/2026 art. 9 §2 — sharing of consumer personal data 'somente poderá ocorrer mediante o prévio consentimento do usuário ou… base legal'. B2B contacts (the owner's name/phone on a CNPJ bill) are still personal data; the electricity bill of a residence is personal data in full. Enforcement precedent: ANPD's FIRST-EVER sanction (DOU 06/07/2023) was Telekall Infoservice, a MICROEMPRESA offering a WhatsApp contact list — fined R$14.400 (capped at 2% of revenue per infraction, art. 52 II) for processing without legal basis (art. 7) plus a warning for no encarregado (art. 41: it could not prove it was not high-risk processing). Buyers push liability down: Lead Energy cl. 3.4 makes the affiliate warrant consent; 3.9 voids 'listas não autorizadas'. COMPLIANT FORM (draft): unticked box 'Autorizo a [MARCA/razão social, CNPJ] a compartilhar meu nome, WhatsApp e os dados da minha conta de luz com até 3 fornecedoras de energia por assinatura parceiras que atendem a minha distribuidora [lista nominal no link], exclusivamente para me enviarem propostas de desconto na conta de luz. Posso revogar a qualquer momento por [e-mail/WhatsApp]; as fornecedoras que receberem meus dados serão informadas a mim.' + separate unticked box for contact by phone call; log timestamp, IP, page version and the exact named recipient list; ship the consent receipt with each lead (CompareSolar already does: 'Compartilhamos esses dados na entrega do lead pra defesa LGPD'). Name an encarregado (or document the small-agent exemption and why the processing is not high-risk) — the Telekall second count.
disputes: THE DISPUTE-IS-THE-PRODUCT LAW holds in this market and the market has already found the repair: define validity as machine-checkable fields at capture and replace automatically. CompareSolar: refund 'automaticamente em até 24 horas. Sem disputa, sem burocracia' on 4 objective criteria (valid CEP via ViaCEP, numeric bill value, WhatsApp mask, distributor resolved); Salyd: 'Reposição Automática' / 'Reposição Garantida'. The GetNinjas seller-side record (already in THE_COROA_KILL.md) is about money for invalid leads ('cobrança por lead inválido e falta de reembolso', 'dados de contato falsos… se recusou a realizar o estorno'); a Reclame Aqui title for a solar lead vendor reads 'Prometem leads qualificados para energia solar e não entregam' (DIGITAL MEDIA) — Reclame Aqui is Cloudflare-blocked (403) so complaint bodies and counts are UNVERIFIED. Pay-per-appointment/-activation moves the fight to THE SELF-REPORTED-CONVERSION TRAP, and the buyers write the trap into their terms: Lead Energy cl. 3.8 'prevalecerão os registros da Plataforma e do sistema interno da LEAD ENERGY', 5.3 lets it re-cut past commissions on its own consumption measurements, 5.4 claws back on any later cancellation; Desperta pays only after the client's first invoice is paid. Third-party measurement: none public per customer — CCEE has no consumer-by-CNPJ dataset (DD3, UNVERIFIED) and ANEEL's GD register gives only a per-PLANT count of beneficiary UCs. The one third-party record is the CUSTOMER'S OWN DISTRIBUTOR BILL, which shows the compensated GD energy after activation (UNVERIFIED per distributor) — a file the customer can forward, C4-clean.
free_front_door: Strong, in five layers. (1) The operators fund their own acquisition: Cemig SIM consortia alone hold 590.238 of 2.167.000 shared-GD beneficiary UCs (27,2%) — the distributor group's own arm; Lead Energy voids leads 'originadas de campanhas internas' (3.7), i.e. it runs its own. (2) Affiliate armies deliver leads FREE until activation: Desperta's partner programme (no fee, no minimums), Sunne, Solarien, Enerlivre; DD3 found Desperta and Ecom each recruiting 1.000 PJ reps — so an operator has a zero-risk alternative to buying a lead, which is the core objection to per-lead pricing. (3) Lead marketplaces: CompareSolar (organic SEO, pre-launch, prepaid per lead); Portal Solar collects bills for ACL ('Anexe uma ou mais contas de Luz'); Clarke and UC Livre compare ACL suppliers free (DD3). (4) SaaS sells the operator the qualifier itself: GDASH (self-service simulation, digital adhesion 'sem depender de agendamentos ou envio de documentos'); Lead Energy's own site 'possui uma inteligência capaz de ler o pdf original de uma conta de luz'. (5) THE CHEAP STATE COUNTER for low-voltage ACL from 25 Nov 2027: Decreto 13.097/2026 art. 10 orders CCEE to run a 'plataforma centralizada que permita a comparação de ofertas'; art. 10 par. único has CCEE notify ALL varejistas of consumers stranded on supplier-of-last-resort; art. 1 §1 III imposes a standard product with a reference price; art. 9 §1 contemplates non-discriminatory sharing of distributor-held consumer data 'com amplo e isonômico acesso aos interessados'. For rooftop solar the seat is free (Solar Task, 8.000+ installers). For São Paulo capital there is almost no GD buyer at all (ELETROPAULO concession: 341 shared-GD beneficiary UCs out of ~2,2M nationally).
ai_edge: Bill parsing is TABLE STAKES, not an edge: Lead Energy's site reads the bill PDF with AI; Portal Solar attaches bills; CompareSolar resolves CEP→distributor and requires the bill value; an 'IA via WhatsApp' pre-budget SaaS is sold to solar integrators (leadssolar.com.br, search snippet only — site reset the connection). What is left for a solo operator in Oct 2026: (1) ROUTING — GD credits can only go to consumers in the same concession as the plant (87% of shared-GD beneficiaries are in MG), so an operator's own funnel wastes every lead outside its concessions and capacity; a neutral router sells each verified bill to whichever of 5–10 buyers can serve it (and routes a rare Grupo A bill to a Cemig-SINERGIA-type CPA worth R$2–9k); (2) PRICE-BY-THE-BILL — price each lead as a fixed % of the verified monthly bill (Lead Energy already prices its meeting bonus at 0,5% of the bill), so value is legible and disputes are arithmetic; (3) a LIVE PORTUGUESE VERIFICATION CALL (now permitted) as a premium tier — the price ladder is observed: raw indication R$0 at Lead Energy vs 'Cliente Elegível' (simulation + meeting) 0,5% of bill ≤R$300; shared R$35–75 vs exclusive R$70–150 at CompareSolar (2×); activation 40–60% of one monthly bill at Desperta; (4) near-zero creative cost (AI video, AIGC-labelled) to test many hooks per concession; (5) a consent receipt shipped with every lead. None of these is a moat; (1) and (3) are the defensible parts because they are a position and a labour the buyer does not want in-house.
cash_cycle: Per-LEAD with PREPAID credits is the only form compatible with C5: the category runs on prepayment (CompareSolar 'créditos pré-pagos… créditos não consumidos retornam'; Salyd and Banca de Leads 'adicione créditos'; GetNinjas moedas prepaid, 3-month expiry; Doutor Leads packs), so buyer cash funds the media and working capital is ≈0 — self-funding within days, not 30. Per-ACTIVATION is not: Desperta pays after the client's first invoice is paid; Lead Energy pays on the 20th after the client's invoice is liquidated, 'cerca de 60 dias desde a emissão da nota fiscal'; GD activation itself needs 1–2 billing cycles (UNVERIFIED) ⇒ 60–120 days of media float. At the bar in the CPA model (≈R$10,7–13,1k media/month at R$320 per activation) the float is R$32–39k — 2,5–15× the US$500–2.500 (R$2,6–13k) C5. Platform floors: TikTok requires ≥US$20/day per ad group (≈R$3.122/month for one) and recommends 3–5 ad groups at ≥10× CPA each — TikTok's learning phase alone can exceed C5; Meta has no such published floor from here (UNVERIFIED) and costs +12,15% tax. ⇒ Start on Meta with buyer-prepaid budgets; add TikTok only once a concession's CPA is known. THE STEADY-STATE KILL does not bite per-lead sales (each unit's media is paid before it is spent) but it bites BUYER demand: an operator buys leads only while a plant has unallocated capacity or churn holes, and new shared plants (≥20 beneficiary UCs) fell 956 (2024) → 605 (2025) → 92 (Jan–Aug 2026) by ANEEL cadastral-update year.

killed_while_hunting.idea: Paid ads to find Grupo A (ACL free-market) companies and sell them as leads/appointments
killed_while_hunting.cause: The universe is ENUMERABLE — ANEEL BDGD lists every medium-voltage unit with CNAE, address, consumption and free-market flag (DD3: 18.017 SP captive private units) — so ads pay to find what a free list already names; the only per-meeting payer found pays 0,5% of the bill capped at R$300 (Lead Energy) and the real money is per signed contract, which is DD3's outbound-call model, not ad arbitrage.

killed_while_hunting.idea: A pre-opening low-voltage ACL lead desk for the 25 Nov 2027 opening
killed_while_hunting.cause: THE CHEAP STATE COUNTER, legislated: Decreto 13.097/2026 art. 10 (CCEE centralised offer-comparison platform), art. 10 par. único (CCEE notifies all varejistas of stranded consumers), art. 1 §1 III (standard product + reference price), art. 9 §1–2 (non-discriminatory consented data sharing); and DD3 prices a low-voltage commercial contract at ≈R$181 under Cemig's formula.

killed_while_hunting.idea: GD 'energia por assinatura' leads from São Paulo capital consumers
killed_while_hunting.cause: No buyer: GD credits only serve the plant's own concession, and the ELETROPAULO (Enel SP) concession has 341 shared-GD beneficiary UCs out of ~2,2M nationally; MG holds 1,92M (87%).

THE FREE FRONT DOOR: Solar Task is free to consumers with '8.000+ empresas instaladoras', up to 3 proposals per request; integrator SaaS with built-in lead capture at R$49,90–99/month (search snippets).

CEM (Res. CFM 2.217/2018) art. 59 forbids a physician to 'Oferecer ou aceitar remuneração ou vantagens por paciente encaminhado ou recebido'; art. 72 forbids ties with firms selling financing/consórcio for medical procedures.

Oversupplied at R$9,51–24 per EXCLUSIVE lead (Salyd live listings still unsold after 1–6 days; Doutor Leads packs R$21,88–24,15) — no spread for a newcomer without scale, and the seat is occupied by ≥5 sellers.

Not killed, demoted: TikTok's minimum is US$20/day per ad group and US$50/day per campaign, and its own guidance is 3–5 ad groups at ≥10× CPA — the learning phase alone can exceed the whole C5 capital; start on Meta with buyer-prepaid budgets.

notes: Energy holds only in one corner: low-voltage GD subscriptions in the concessions where GD actually lives (Cemig/MG = 87% of 2,2M shared-GD beneficiaries per ANEEL, Aug 2026). The founder's literal model (TikTok ads → sell leads) is repaired to: Meta first, own landing page/WhatsApp capture with named-recipient consent, bill verified by an AI agent, sold ONLY against prepaid orders, priced as a % of the verified bill, with machine-arbitrated replacement. The observed buyer money in energy is per ACTIVATION (Desperta 40–60% of one bill; Lead Energy per eligible meeting 0,5% of bill ≤R$300; Cemig per signed Grupo A contract) — per-lead in energy is only ASKED (CompareSolar, pre-launch). That gap is exactly what the R$0 week-1 test measures. Dates verified at planalto.gov.br: Lei 15.269 of 24 Nov 2025 (DOU 25 Nov 2025) and Decreto 13.097 of 12 Aug 2026 art. 1: 25 Nov 2027 for low-voltage industrial/commercial, 25 Nov 2028 for everyone else. Lei 14.300 art. 27: Fio B on compensated energy for post-2022 GD 60% (2026), 75% (2027), 90% (2028), art. 17 rule from 2029 — the GD subscription discount erodes for new plants. C8: energy is outside her world (DD3 agrees); candidate 2's salon opener is cosmetic. Revealed preferences: candidate 1 keeps the MACHINE TEST (ads + AI make the unit, the bill verifies it without trusting her) and trades ORIGINATION ONCE on the consumer side (media bought forever) while buyer demand recurs by prepaid top-ups; candidate 2 trades both for a higher unit price. Arithmetic recomputed in work/la1 (both candidates) — the whole case turns on one unmeasured number: the cost of a bill-verified eligible lead.
